transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what’s been going on that brought you in today?

Well… I guess I came in because I just can’t seem to settle myself lately. It’s hard to explain without sounding dramatic, but it feels like I’m restless inside my own skin, like I need to get up and do the next thing even when I’m tired and should just be sitting still. I don’t know if that makes sense.
Have you noticed your heart racing or felt palpitations along with this restlessness?
I don’t think so… not that I’ve really noticed. I mean, I get unsettled, but I wouldn’t say my heart is racing or pounding, at least not that I can tell. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Have you been experiencing any sweating, trembling, or shaking along with this restlessness?
No, I don’t think so. I mean, I haven’t noticed sweating or shaking like that. I can feel keyed up, but not trembling, at least not that I’m aware of. Does that sound right?
Have you noticed that you don’t enjoy things as much as you used to, or that you’ve lost interest in activities you normally like doing?

I don’t think I’d say I’ve lost interest, no. I still like the things I usually like… maybe I don’t always get to them or stick with them the way I should, but it’s not that they don’t feel enjoyable anymore. At least, I don’t think so. Is that what you mean?
Have you been feeling more tired than usual or noticed a lack of energy lately, even if you’re not doing anything physically demanding?
I’m not sure I’d say more tired than usual, no. I mean, I have days where I’m kind of worn out, but I don’t think it’s a lack of energy in that way. Maybe just normal for me? Is that okay to say?
Do you find yourself worrying more than usual, or having trouble controlling your worries about things?

I don’t think so… I mean, I worry about normal things, like anyone does, but I wouldn’t say it’s more than usual or that I can’t control it. At least, I haven’t really noticed that being the main problem. Does that answer it okay?
Have you found yourself feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, for at least the past two weeks?
No, I don’t think so. I mean, I have moments where I feel a little low or frustrated, but not down most of the day nearly every day. I wouldn’t want to overstate it. Does that make sense?
Do you find yourself having real difficulty staying seated when you need to, like at work or during meetings?

Yes… I think that’s actually a big part of why I came in. I don’t want to make it sound dramatic, but it feels like I can’t really settle inside my own skin anymore. Like even if I’m worn out and I know I should just sit still, there’s this push to get up and do the next thing. Is that the kind of thing you mean?

latest_inference.note: The patient's symptoms align more closely with F90.0 (Attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder, predominantly hyperactive type) based on the persistent restlessness, difficulty staying seated, and an internal sense of being driven to move or act. Symptoms do not support a primary anxiety (F41.0) or depressive disorder, as there is no significant worry, autonomic arousal, anhedonia, or depressed mood reported.
